title: Granularity vs. Meticulousness
summary: Structure describes the target. Execution determines whether it exists.
body: Granularity is judgment: what resolution should the work have, given the result you want? Meticulousness is fidelity: once that resolution is chosen, does the result actually realize it? Choosing a fine or coarse coffee grind is granularity. Producing a tight distribution instead of boulders and fines is meticulousness. More detail gives work a finer shape, not higher quality.
